Samantha — got it, and thanks for the attachments. Confirming Wed 7/22 14:00–15:00 PT for the kickoff. We’ll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Initial scope items we propose to include in the kickoff and questionnaire review:
- Systems in scope: production inference API (hosted by Redwood in us-west region), embeddings store, customer-provided S3 for artifact storage (if used), and the analytics job that reads anonymized outputs.
- Data types: clinical notes (PHI) in requests; logs and traces retained for 30 days by default; we can discuss retention/longer-term options.
- Controls to review: encryption (in transit & at rest), key management options, access controls (RBAC), audit logging, SOC2 evidence, data deletion flows, and incident response.

Neha — can you lead the questionnaire intake and produce a short answers-first pass before the call? Vivek — can you prepare a one-slide architecture summary + brief notes on where KV/embeddings are stored so we can clarify what is/isn’t in-scope.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short Redwood instructions doc to help your team navigate the questionnaire (format expectations and common answers).

See you Wed.

- Marissa

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks — confirming Wed 7/22 14:00 PT. I’ll lead the questionnaire intake on Redwood’s side and will circulate an initial answers draft by tomorrow noon PT so your team can review before the kickoff.

A few questions to help scope the intake (short answers welcome):
1) Confirm whether the embeddings store should be treated as containing PHI for your internal risk model (we’ve seen customers treat embeddings as sensitive when they are directly re-identifiable).
2) Are there any customer-hosted components (e.g., proxy, S3 buckets) that we should plan to include in the architecture review?
3) Is there a policy on external vendor subprocessor locations? We’ll note that Redwood’s hosted control plane is in us-west; we can discuss additional restrictions.

Deliverables we’ll provide before the call: initial answers spreadsheet (draft), SOC2 summary, short architecture slide.

Proposed agenda for the 60-min kickoff: 1) Introductions & decision roles (10m), 2) High-level Redwood architecture (10m), 3) Walk questionnaire sections and clarify scope (30m), 4) Next steps and procurement timeline (10m).

Attached: draft answers (work in progress) — we’ll finish internal QA tomorrow morning.
